messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Dedicated pool 'crestview-enterprise' GPU queue depth > 95% for 3m. Single tenant spike detected. Paging Maya (oncall).
Maya: ack I'm awake. Looking into the pool.
Maya: running quick check `gputop --pool crestview-enterprise --last 15m` ... GPU_util=98%, queue=420, avg_latency=4.8s
Alice: Confirmed crestview tenant is pinned to that pool; autoscale is disabled (min==max).
Ben: We can enable burst override but need ops/finance signoff. Options: eviction, throttle, burst.
Sam-AM: Pinged AMs and customer on-call.
Carla: Customer reports 503s and timeouts on generation endpoints. Impact ~4% of requests, concentrated on long-context jobs.
Maya: Proposed mitigations: 1) run eviction to free GPUs from background low-priority jobs 2) apply short-term rate-limit for long-context routes 3) request burst allocation (temp) while we stabilize.
Ops-Bot: Created burst-request BR-9243: +10 GPUs for 20m. Cost estimate ~$480.
Alice: Eviction policy ready. Command: `infractl pool evict --pool crestview-enterprise --policy reclaim-low-priority --threshold 85`
Maya: executing eviction now.
Ops-Bot: Eviction started — reclaimed 32 low-priority jobs.
Ben: queue dropped to 280, GPU_util=86% and latency down a bit.
Sam-AM: Reached out to Lia (customer) via AM, she's on the line.
Lia-Crestview: via AM — we're seeing degraded throughput, can delay some non-critical batches.
Carla: Applying temporary throttle: `rlctl set --tenant=crestview --route=/generate --rps=20`
Maya: Monitoring logs, 503s falling to ~0.8%. Seeing some tails due to cold KV cache.
Ops-Bot: BR-9243 approved by finance. Provisioning +10 GPUs (ETA ~2m).
Maya: Still seeing a few straggling long requests — KV cache warmup might help.
Alice: Triggering cache warmup: `infractl cache warmup --model llama-65b --tenant crestview --coverage 0.7`
Ben: After warmup and burst allocation, GPU_util=62%, tail latencies resolved.
Maya: I'm going to hand off — I need a 20m break. Sean please take ownership and keep an eye on the pool and customer comms.
Sean: Taking over. TL;DR: eviction + throttle applied, burst active, cache warmup done, customer stable.
Sam-AM: Customer asks for RCA and whether we can enable autoscale or adjust pool configs to avoid recurrence.
Alice: Logged action INFRA-1120: enable autoscale for dedicated pools when single-tenant usage >70% for 5m, plus runbook updates for urgent burst flows.
Maya: We'll keep monitoring for 30m, will escalate if any regressions. :thumbsup:
